identified_hotspots.name: Frankfurt (Oder) / Słubice Groyne Field Stagnation Zone
identified_hotspots.vulnerability_driver: Low river flow (<0.2 m/s), high water temp (>25°C), and stagnant water retention between river groynes.
identified_hotspots.prescribed_intervention: Targeted hydraulic flushing pulse (45-60 m³/s) and mobile boat aeration.

identified_hotspots.name: Kostrzyn nad Odrą Confluence Backwater
identified_hotspots.vulnerability_driver: Nutrient concentration and slow water exchange at the Warta-Oder river junction.
identified_hotspots.prescribed_intervention: Suspend riverbank filtration wells; increase water quality grab sampling cadence to 12h.

water_authority_advisory.headline: CRITICAL ALGAL BLOOM EMERGENCY
water_authority_advisory.action_recommendation: Issue public contact recreation ban. Divert municipal drinking water intakes to secondary/deep intakes. Initiate activated carbon dosing at treatment facilities. Deploy floating boom barriers around critical harbor and marina zones.
